sweeps.name: topology-pp
sweeps.narrative: TP8 should peak highest, since every pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to each decode step.

sweeps.name: topology-dp
sweeps.narrative: Data-parallel attention should beat pipeline stages at the same tp, and EP should matter more at dp 4 than dp 2.

sweeps.name: batch-caps
sweeps.narrative: A seq cap of 8 should bind on TP8 but not on TP2 DP4, whose four attention ranks each see a quarter of the lanes.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: fp8 KV and higher memory utilization should substitute on TP8 but add on TP2 DP4, which replicates attention weights.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: DeepEP low-latency should win on TP8, and the gap should shrink on TP2 DP4, where sequence-parallel MoE splits the batch.

sweeps.name: prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.

objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs
